summary.headline: Summary of First-Class Mail received by households for fiscal year 2023.

statements.text: For All households, First-Class Mail received by households was 32,228.0 millions of pieces in FY2023.
First-Class Mail received by households decreased by 1,319.0 millions of pieces from the previous year in FY2023.
First-Class Mail received by households fell by 6,730.0 millions of pieces from 5 years earlier in FY2023.

caveats: Beginning in 2010, diary data were restated because of changes in weighting methodology (Appendix A8 table notes). Values before 2010 use the earlier weighting.

From the FY2024 report, results are published as pieces per household per year, and the survey contractor changed (NuStats to RCF). The FY2024 report restated 2014-2023 on its own basis, so its values for those years can differ slightly from earlier reports (e.g. bills paid by mail in 2014: 34% in FY2023, 33% in FY2024).

FY2025 used a new survey design (renamed the Household Mail Survey); Q1 was still covered by the old survey. Age bands changed to Under 45 / 45-64 / 65+ (previously 18-34 / 35-54 / 55+), and 'Large MSA' was redefined in January 2025 from the top 30 metros to metros of 1 million or more.

summary.headline: First-Class Mail received by all households saw significant declines over multiple periods, with ongoing downward projections through FY2028.

statements.text: For All households, First-Class Mail received by households fell by 24,577.0 millions of pieces across the FY2010 methodology break from 2000 to 2023.
For All households, First-Class Mail received by households decreased by 17,835.0 millions of pieces since the latest break from 2010 to 2023.
For All households, First-Class Mail received by households fell by 11,914.0 millions of pieces from 2013 to 2023.
For All households, First-Class Mail received by households decreased by 6,730.0 millions of pieces from 2018 to 2023.
For All households, First-Class Mail received by households fell by 1,319.0 millions of pieces from 2022 to 2023.
For All households, First-Class Mail received by households is projected at 30,856.0 millions of pieces in 2024, with an 80% prediction interval 29998.0 to 31714.0.
For All households, First-Class Mail received by households is projected at 25,368.0 millions of pieces in 2028, with an 80% prediction interval 23270.0 to 27467.0.
